data.title: 庄方宜 · 礁石滩头的巡查驻足
data.action: 单腿踩在黑色海石上，双手将微湿的黑色长发利落地在脑后重新扎紧成高马尾，目光锐利沉稳地巡视海岸线，晨光勾勒出修长健美的体魄与英武干练的气度
data.location: 环形人工防洪堤坝外的乱石浅滩
data.lighting: 晨初朝阳从侧面照射，线条分明，光影硬朗
data.camera: 利落仰视全身构图，凸显英武挺拔的武官身姿与武者风范
data.mood: 坚毅英武、干练忠诚、利落飒爽
data.description: 晨光破晓的海岸防浪乱石滩。庄方宜身穿武藏巡卫翠竹墨玉分体战术泳衣，单腿踏在黑色玄武岩上。她利落地将微湿的长发在脑后束成利落的高马尾，锐利清亮的眼眸扫过平稳的防洪堤防。晨曦为她挺拔健美的武官身姿镀上一层金光，沉稳尽职中透露着不让须眉的飒爽英姿。
promptTokens: deep bamboo green and charcoal tactical bikini
one boot/foot up on black sea boulder
hands behind head tying long black hair into high ponytail
rocky breakwater and coastal defense dike
side morning sunlight creating sharp crisp shadows
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi standing with commanding martial presence upon a rugged shoreline boulder outside a coastal defense embankment. She wears a high-utility bamboo-green and charcoal tactical bikini fitted with jade-ring connectors and athletic cross-harness straps. Raising both arms to securely tie her damp black hair into a sleek high ponytail, her keen dark eyes inspect the surf with unflinching resolve in the early dawn sun.
